variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, isolated UI component exploration. Generate ONLY ONE compact draggable bidirectional HANDLE for the bottom edge of a Korean employment card. Absolutely no job card, app screen, phone frame, navigation, company content, background scenery, hand, human, extra button row, title, variant label, explanation, annotations, or multiple components. Output a transparent-background cutout with the handle tightly framed, generous small even padding, suitable as an isolated UI design asset. Crisp professional 2D app interface rendering, smooth edges, restrained extremely subtle elevation. Mature, elegant, touch-friendly, simple enough to implement with HTML/CSS.
Palette: warm coral #FF536F, dark navy #20324D, very pale blue-gray #F1F4F9, white #FFFFFF. Preserve these colors across all variants. Do NOT add purple, teal, orange, gradients, chrome or glossy 3D materials.
Interaction: user grips the SAME handle at its center; pushes UP to flip the parent job card and choose a rejection reason; pulls DOWN to apply, taking the entire parent card down. Only show idle handle design, not parent card or motion frames. Directional meaning must be visually obvious, always vertical, never left/right. Use exact clear Korean text "밀어서 넘기기" with upward arrow above the grab point, and "당겨서 지원" with downward arrow below the grab point. These labels are part of the handle itself, not captions outside the component. Add a tactile dot/dash grip mark to the same central draggable surface. No English text. Typography contemporary Korean sans serif. Draw one cohesive handle, not two disconnected buttons. All Korean letters must be legible and correct.
DESIGN 1 — HORIZONTAL CAPSULE GRIP. A wide low-profile pale blue-gray rounded capsule around 240 wide by 115 high logical pixels. The capsule is a single handle surface: its upper third has a small navy upward chevron followed by "밀어서 넘기기"; its CENTER has three short thick parallel navy grip dashes; its lower third has a coral downward chevron followed by bold "당겨서 지원". Rounded capsule corners, tiny coral bottom-edge accent, neutral background. The central grip reads as a small raised horizontal thumb landing pad, integrated rather than a separate button. Broad, minimal and understated. Tightly framed standalone cutout.

DESIGN 2 — CIRCULAR THUMB PAD WITH WINGS. One vertically symmetrical compact grip about 160 wide by 175 high logical pixels, with a clearly dominant central coral circular thumb pad, white six-dot grip pattern, and small short broad pale blue-gray rounded wings extending UP and DOWN from the circle. The UP wing includes navy up arrow and exact label "밀어서 넘기기", split into two short lines if needed. The DOWN wing includes coral down arrow and label "당겨서 지원", split into two short lines if needed. Both wings physically merge into the circular handle so it is one integrated directional component. No track, no external bar or second button. Clean flat rendering, comfortable thumb affordance, very slight elevation on central circle. Standalone cutout only.

DESIGN 3 — HANGING RIBBON TAB. One medium-width vertical pull tab about 170 wide by 190 high logical pixels. The top edge is flat with gently rounded top corners, sides straight, bottom a single broad smoothly rounded tongue. Very pale blue-gray upper half with navy up chevron and "밀어서 넘기기". The lower half is solid coral with large white down chevron and "당겨서 지원". At the shared middle, a restrained horizontal white raised grip strip with three short navy tactile marks. The tab looks like a flexible pull tongue that would attach to a card, but do NOT draw any card or attachment surface. No realistic fabric stitching. Minimal native-app UI, solid colors, smooth geometry. It remains ONE grippable tab, not a pair of press buttons.

Directly attached above the loop is a small pale blue-gray inset plate, navy upward chevron and exact "밀어서 넘기기". Directly attached below the loop is a small pale blue-gray inset plate with coral downward chevron and exact "당겨서 지원". Plates visually merge into the loop frame, minimal spacing and no loose caption text. Airy hollow center, flat elegant design, no stems extending into a card, no photo realism, no detached buttons.

DESIGN 5 — WAISTED DOUBLE-ENDED GRIP. One sculpted but flat 2D handle about 210 wide by 165 high logical pixels, shaped like a smooth hourglass/sandglass with broad rounded TOP and BOTTOM ends and an inward-curved narrow waist in the center. TOP end pale blue-gray contains navy up arrow and "밀어서 넘기기". BOTTOM end solid coral contains white down arrow and "당겨서 지원". Center waist is dark navy with six small white tactile dots, clearly indicating where to grab. Maintain seamless one-piece silhouette; no joining seams that suggest separate buttons. Mature polished app styling; very soft subtle shadow only. No cartoon bow, ribbon knot, heart, decorative symbols, or other UI. Standalone tightly cropped transparent component.
